headline: Tech stocks bounced Monday but the 10-year yield climbed back to 5.14%, and BTC faded from its high to close near the bottom of its range; ETFs lost $228M last week while weighted funding rose to 9.77% — leverage is still running ahead of spot.
summary: BTC pushed to 83,100 on Monday but closed back at 81,844, at 13.5% of the day's range; volume recovered to 0.86× the 20-day average. ETFs confirmed −$82.4M for 10/16, putting the last 7 complete trading days at −$451M, and the Coinbase premium stayed negative — spot demand is still weak; weighted funding is 9.77% and STH-SOPR is back at 1.0032. Market stage remains Bull (day 11); no exit-framework rule has fired or is close. Next to watch: whether ETF outflows stop, oil and yields, and the 10/27–28 FOMC.

cycle.lead: Market stage: Bull (since 2026-10-09, day 11); 40 straight closes above the rising 200-day MA (threshold 30).
points: 200-day MA 72,569, above 70,463 thirty days ago and still rising; capitulation already seen (2026-06-30, 58,525).

Evidence lights 3/6 (strength of evidence only, not part of the call): on — MVRV above its 1-year mean (1.521 vs 1.433), realized cap 30-day +1.25%, close above STH cost basis 74,488 (10/13); off — 12-month momentum (−23.5%), exchange supply 90-day (+1.12%), STH cost vs true market mean (−6.11%, 10/13).

Readings: linearly extrapolating the last 30 days, STH cost would cross above the true market mean around 12/15 (prior estimate 12/12); assuming a flat price, 12-month momentum would turn positive around 2027-01-31 — both are assumptions, not forecasts.
By rule, Bull reverts to Bear only after 30 straight closes below a falling 200-day MA; days below now 0. Tidemark low test: no break of 58,525 before 12/19.

news.title: Tech rebounded Monday: Nasdaq +1.11% to 26,431 and the Philadelphia semiconductor index snapped an 8-session losing streak; but Houthi claims of strikes on Saudi energy sites lifted oil — WTI +2.22% to $103.66 — and the 10-year Treasury yield rose 4.2 bp to 5.14%
news.read: BTC's 30-day correlation with the Nasdaq is 0.668, and BTC did push to 83,100 as stocks bounced, but yields rose alongside and BTC closed near the bottom of its range — rate pressure is still offsetting risk appetite. The site's FRED 10-year 5.09% and real yield 2.74% (10/16) remain elevated; macro backdrop only, nowhere near the 200-day MA (−11.3%) or any exit condition.

news.title: US spot BTC ETFs saw about $229M of net outflows last week, a second straight negative week; ETH ETFs lost about $320M, with October at about −$955M; BTC ETF year-to-date net inflows only about $259M
news.read: Matches the site's The Block total of −$228.4M for 10/12–10/16. The last 7 complete trading days are −$451M (prior −$856M, as 10/07's −$487M dropped out of the window) — outflows are shrinking but not yet positive; with the Coinbase premium at −0.123%, US spot demand remains the weakest link. Weak flows, not a framework condition.

news.title: Strategy 8-K: bought 267 BTC for about $22.1M (avg 82,900) over 10/12–10/18 while repurchasing about $193M of STRC preferred, and raised its buyback authorization from $2B to $3B; total holdings 848,517 BTC
news.read: For a second week, BTC buying was only about one-ninth of the preferred buyback — the largest listed holder is still prioritizing support for its preferred stock, so non-ETF demand keeps slowing. No direct site metric; a medium-term institutional backdrop that does not change the cycle call. Next: the 10/28 STRC special meeting and the 11/11 MSCI list.

news.title: Brent fell as much as 2.08% to $107.57 in Asian trading Monday (the US waived some Russia sanctions on Friday), then recovered after US security alerts for 12 Middle East locations; Kpler says Gulf crude flows fell to about 8.5M barrels/day last week from over 20M the week before (unverified)
news.source: Bitcoin News Digest (citing Reuters, CNA, Kpler), 2026-10-19
news.read: The Russia waiver only briefly pushed oil lower; supply risk around Hormuz and Saudi Arabia keeps Brent near $109, so inflation and hike expectations are slow to fade — one reason the 10-year is back at 5.14%. A headwind for risk appetite, not a change to the market stage.

news.title: Strive 8-K: bought 1,223 BTC over 10/14–10/16 (avg ~81,734), total 36,818 BTC; its ~$630M SATS preferred offering settles Tuesday
news.read: Larger than Strategy's buying that week but still small next to the ETFs' −$228M week; sporadic corporate buying with no site metric attached — changes nothing.

news.title: Lookonchain: MARA-linked wallets deposited about 1,000 BTC to Binance and Gate over five days; the company has not explained the transfers (unverified)
news.read: Miner deposits to exchanges are usually read as potential selling, but the size is small against ~452 BTC/day of new issuance and exchange supply 7-day +0.18%; hashrate 7-day avg 1,031.5 EH/s with no hash-ribbon capitulation shows no forced miner selling — short-term noise.

news.title: China's Q3 GDP grew 4.5% y/y (forecast 4.4%, prior 4.3%); retail sales +1.1% (forecast 0.5%)
news.read: Slightly better than expected, mildly supportive of global risk appetite but with limited pass-through to BTC; no site metric — changes nothing.
